The repo keeps fixtures in three places: tests/fixtures/, tests/fixtures/old/ and a handful of inline JSON blobs inside tests/test_loader.py. The loader in src/loader/fixtures.py resolves names through FIXTURE_PATHS, which is built at import time from the FIXTURES_DIR environment variable and two hard-coded fallbacks. Some of the old fixtures date from the 1.x schema and may no longer be referenced. Look at how FIXTURE_PATHS is built, which helpers call load_fixture(), and whether any test still names a file that lives under tests/fixtures/old/. Pay attention to parametrize decorators, since they build names from string templates.
